transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this weekly facilities huddle started. We've got four operating areas that need generator power over the next 24 hours — the clinic, communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance workshop — and only two generators, G-1 and G-2, which can't be run in parallel. Before I sign off on any schedule, I need each of you to report your current operating requirements. Medical, signal, facilities, logistics — what do you need from the generators in the next 24 hours?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important for the schedule: the clinic's vaccine refrigerator was moved to the G-1 circuit during a repair yesterday and must remain on G-1 continuously for the next 24 hours. I confirmed the connection with the clinic technician this morning, but the circuit change is not yet on the facilities drawing. This means the clinic must be assigned to G-1, not G-2, in whatever schedule we finalize.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something for the schedule as well: the communications shelter has a mandatory battery load test from 1000 to 1100 tomorrow, and the shelter must remain on G-2 throughout that entire test. I received the test notice from the signal maintenance team this morning, but it's not yet on the daily power slide. This means the communications shelter must be assigned to G-2, at least during that window.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag something for the schedule as well: the workshop's exhaust system inspection requires the workshop to run from exactly 1400 to 1600 tomorrow, and the workshop circuit must be isolated from the cold-storage circuit during that inspection. I recorded the inspection booking today, but the work window has not been entered in the generator schedule yet.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical for the schedule: the next fuel delivery arrives at exactly 1700 tomorrow, and fuel on hand only supports G-2 for 16 operating hours. To preserve communications and clinic continuity, G-2 must be scheduled offline from exactly 0100 to 0900 tomorrow, with the workshop remaining on G-1 after its inspection window. I received the carrier confirmation this morning, but the revised fuel timing has not been posted to the power plan yet.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Update facilities drawings to reflect the vaccine refrigerator's move to the G-1 circuit.
Add the communications shelter battery load test (1000-1100) to the daily power slide.
Enter the workshop exhaust inspection window (1400-1600) into the generator schedule.
Post the revised fuel delivery timing (1700 tomorrow) and G-2 offline window (0100-0900) to the power plan.
Routine generator status review at 0800 tomorrow as part of the baseline plan.
